meta.name: ai-research-reproduction
meta.description: Rigor Reproduce compatible skill slug for README-first deep learning repository reproduction. Use when the user wants an end-to-end, minimal-trustworthy flow that reads the repository first, selects the smallest documented inference or evaluation target, coordinates intake, setup, trusted execution, optional trusted training, optional repository analysis, and optional paper-gap resolution, enforces conservative patch rules, records evidence assumptions deviations and human decision points, and writes the standardized `repro_outputs/` bundle. Do not use for paper summary, generic environment setup, isolated repo scanning, standalone command execution, silent protocol changes, score chasing, or broad research assistance outside repository-grounded reproduction.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动复现深度学习研究仓库的实验结果
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要严格复现深度学习论文的代码并记录所有步骤
copy.tagline_en: Automatically reproduce deep learning research repositories with standardized outputs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to rigorously reproduce deep learning paper code and document all steps

howto.what: Claude会先阅读仓库README，自动选择最小的可信目标（如推理或评估），然后设置环境、运行命令、记录结果与偏差，最后在repro_outputs/输出标准化报告。代码修改会被严格记录。
howto.when: 当用户要求端到端复现一个深度学习仓库的结果，且希望先读README、最小化可信执行时触发。涉及读取、选择目标、设置、运行、报告等多个阶段。

say.text: 复现这个GitHub仓库的最小推理结果。
say.note: Claude会启动流程，选择推理目标并执行。

say.text: 按README步骤评估模型，保存证据。
say.note: Claude会读取README，设置环境并运行评估。

say.text: 尝试复现训练，先验证能否启动。
say.note: Claude会执行训练启动，但会在完整训练前暂停确认。

howto.what_en: Claude reads the repository README, selects the smallest reproducible target (inference/evaluation), then sets up environment, runs commands, records results & deviations, and writes standardized outputs to repro_outputs/. Code changes are strictly logged.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user requests end-to-end reproduction of a deep learning repository with a README-first, minimal-trustworthy approach spanning intake, target selection, setup, execution, and reporting.

say_en.text: Reproduce the minimal inference result from this GitHub repo.
say_en.note: Claude initiates the pipeline and runs inference.

say_en.text: Follow the README to evaluate and save evidence.
say_en.note: Claude reads README, sets up env, and runs evaluation.

say_en.text: Try to reproduce training, just verify it starts.
say_en.note: Claude runs training startup but pauses before full run.
